directoryStems.mcq-b6010174acb8db2434926ba0: איזה מהבאים מהווה גורם סיכון לקרצינומה של הערמונית?
directoryStems.mcq-44ec5232c3b70be5ec3546a8: בן 84, עצמאי ושמור קוגניטיבית, ברקע יתר לחץ דם מאוזן ומחלת קרוהן בהפוגה. אובחן כסובל מקרצינומה של הערמונית Gleason 5 ללא גרורות. הוא מתלבט בין טיפולים מקומיים שהוצעו לו. איזה שיקול ינחה את תכנית הטיפול המקומי בקרצינומה של הערמונית?
directoryStems.mcq-1cb99f3372af2cc90f4f9375: A 68-year-old man has newly diagnosed T1c prostate cancer, PSA 6.2 ng/mL, Gleason score 6, and two positive cores out of twelve. He has controlled diabetes, mild hypertension, takes metformin and lisinopril, and has ECOG performance status 0. He is concerned about quality of life. Which strategy uses scheduled monitoring while retaining the prospect of delayed, potentially curative treatment if progression is detected?
directoryStems.mcq-cafc04a7f27715c56200ef28: An 82-year-old man has high-risk nonmetastatic prostate cancer. He has no disease-related symptoms, and comorbidities limit his estimated life expectancy to three to four years. After discussion with him, watchful waiting is selected. Which change triggers treatment within this approach?
directoryStems.mcq-4da6fb9bc45aae6036dde3f5: A 76-year-old man with metastatic prostate cancer presents after a fall. He has had increasing back pain for a month and difficulty walking. Examination shows L2–L3 tenderness, bilateral leg weakness (4/5), and reduced reflexes. PSA has risen to 67 ng/mL despite androgen deprivation therapy. X-rays show osteoblastic lesions in several vertebrae. Which approach to possible spinal cord compression follows Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-f856d60d69318d56b9d040e2: A 74-year-old man with localized prostate cancer and ulcerative colitis is discussing treatment options. Which explanation agrees with Hazzard’s prostate cancer chapter?
directoryStems.mcq-ab8dc490dc815657a2d58a92: An 81-year-old man receiving androgen deprivation therapy for prostate cancer has osteoporosis. In addition to evaluating falls and nutrition, which approach to bone health is supported by Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-387917d4060a5205b0e628ea: Biochemical recurrence is detected after radical prostatectomy. Which measure is useful for monitoring and deciding when to initiate treatment?
directoryStems.mcq-c63ca22222dd103d94280246: A 72-year-old man with localized prostate cancer is considering active surveillance rather than immediate treatment. He has T1c disease, PSA 4.8 ng/mL, Gleason score 6, and 3 of 12 positive biopsy cores. His hypertension is controlled and he is otherwise healthy. He worries about missing the opportunity for curative treatment. Which counseling statement accords with Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-9429aa2262c51cff40966775: An 85-year-old man with heart failure, diabetes, and chronic kidney disease has a PSA of 12 ng/mL and an abnormal digital rectal examination. Biopsy reveals prostate adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 7. He has been hospitalized twice this year for heart-failure exacerbations, needs help with activities of daily living, and has an estimated life expectancy of 2–3 years. He has no urinary symptoms. His care plan is to defer cancer treatment until symptomatic disease develops. Which strategy does this describe?
directoryStems.mcq-ed1780e7e9c21bbbae2bc8ef: A 79-year-old man has localized prostate cancer (Gleason 3+4, PSA 8.2), type 2 diabetes (HbA1c 7.8%), and stage 3b CKD (eGFR 42; Cockcroft–Gault creatinine clearance 38 mL/min). He uses a walker after a recent hip fracture and has ECOG performance status 2. His medications are metformin 1000 mg twice daily, tamsulosin 0.4 mg daily, and alendronate 70 mg weekly. Estimated life expectancy is 6 years. After discussion, he chooses to defer cancer treatment until symptomatic disease develops, rather than plan delayed curative treatment. Which strategy describes this choice?
directoryStems.mcq-d41f93795051f8d1fc730304: A man with prostate cancer develops new, severe back pain, raising concern for spinal cord compression. He has no neurologic deficit on examination. What initial approach is appropriate according to Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-29e39f7543975951b910a29a: An 82-year-old man with localized low-risk prostate cancer asks about active surveillance and the possibility of later curative treatment. He has moderate COPD, diabetes with neuropathy, polypharmacy including gabapentin and oxybutynin, recurrent falls with declining daily function, and reduced renal function. Which description of active surveillance agrees with Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-a4cd359ebdc75203c9ddd5a3: After radical prostatectomy, a patient's PSA does not fall to an undetectable level. Which evaluation does Hazzard recommend?
directoryStems.mcq-72541940bedda98dab309c51: According to Hazzard, which statement describes the use of prostate brachytherapy in relation to disease risk and prostate size?
directoryStems.mcq-d55333cad133258b1c0062e9: A 77-year-old man is undergoing active surveillance for low-risk prostate cancer. A repeat biopsy now shows primary Gleason pattern 4. Which management change does this finding support?
directoryStems.mcq-58bf3aa2160aacc4c9828773: An older adult with castration-resistant prostate cancer is being considered for enzalutamide. Which history calls for the specific neurologic caution described in Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-439d51efbe2a3e1bc488ba94: An 83-year-old man with castration-resistant prostate cancer and extensive bone metastases has severe back pain despite morphine 30 mg every 4 hours. Pain prevents independent transfers; he previously walked with a walker. MRI shows multilevel vertebral metastases without cord compression. Creatinine is 1.8 mg/dL. His severe pain is localized to one spinal area. Which basis for palliative radiation referral accords with Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-0d156c081c78a3384fdfdbbc: A 77-year-old man is starting androgen-deprivation therapy for prostate cancer. He asks how treatment affects bone health. Which approach is consistent with Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-dc034cba2bb5ba38b87ef87c: Watchful waiting is discussed with a man who has prostate cancer. Which principle defines this approach in Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-8d614ab4fa13b1d541dd33b8: An older man with high-risk prostate cancer is asymptomatic and has a limited life expectancy. He and his team are considering watchful waiting. What distinguishes this approach from active surveillance intended to permit delayed curative treatment?
directoryStems.mcq-ac3eccdcd0b272b7e74ac6e3: בן 97, שמור קוגניטיבית, מתהלך עם הליכון ונזקק לעזרה חלקית ב- ADL, נבדק עקב כאבי עצמות מפושטים ואובחן כסובל מ- CARCINOMA OF PROSTATE עם גרורות לעצמות. PSA-1000. מה הטיפול המומלץ?
directoryStems.mcq-e1679665a965ea90eade835b: בן 85 הסובל מ- CARCINOMA OF PROSTATE עם גרורות לעצמות. מה נכון לגבי הטיפול התומך?
